summary: Implemented exact product identity, resumable bulk merge correctness, guarded scanner/search parity, fail-closed undo activation, lifecycle cleanup, truthful review copy, and current merge gate coverage without production writes.
changes: cloudflare/src/routes/products.ts: enforces exact identity and numeric validity, preserves immutable whole-cluster economics across partial failure/retry, bounds requests to 25 cases, reparents the product graph, records each case atomically, and quarantines stale or oversized clusters.

cloudflare/src/lib/productMerge.ts and frontend/src/utils/productMerge.ts: compute one DISTINCT positive-cost mean across the whole cluster, round upward once to four decimals, retain maximum retail/wholesale prices, and expose immutable retry-plan validation.
cloudflare/src/lib/undoAppliers.ts: stores mutation/history/audit together and keeps action history non-reversible until fingerprint storage and action activation succeed in one guarded batch.
cloudflare/src/lib/productIdentity.ts and frontend product grouping: normalize leading-zero-equivalent exact identities and choose a clean canonical displayed barcode.

cloudflare/src/lib/searchMatch.ts, cloudflare/src/lib/productSearchQuery.ts, and frontend/src/utils/searchMatch.ts: add checked UPC-E/UPC-A equivalence while preventing seven-digit internal-code collisions through fuzzy, FTS, trigram, and fallback search.
BarcodeScannerModal.tsx and ScanSearchButton.tsx: close successful scans once, reject stale callbacks, release tracks, require user camera action, and stop denied-permission retry loops.

MergeDuplicatesReviewModal.tsx, ProductDuplicatesTab.tsx, and productWriteTransport.ts: provide bounded/resumable merge contracts, cancellation, truthful blocked-group/undo language, horizontal product-name access, and a stable request transport.
Focused and legacy product merge/scanner tests now exercise real helpers and database effects; identity_i18n.json supplies exact English/Khmer strings for separately owned language maps.
